claim: *Cause travels with consequence.* A cause mints an identity; the identity rides action to change to artifact; from the final artifact the identity lets a reader reconstruct why, not just what.
topology:
A causal event mints an identity, then that identity travels alongside the work. The action
    produces a change, the change produces an artifact, and the same identity is carried under all three as a
    provenance rail. Because the identity moved with the work rather than being inferred afterward, the final
    artifact can reconstruct why it changed, not merely what changed.
bw_encoding: Causal origin and reconstructed explanation differ from neutral action/change/artifact chain. All text black; fills are grayscale and redundant with labels, position or border style.
redesign: Layout reflowed for a 15 cm monochrome print column; color categories replaced by labels and boundary weight.
alt: C.8 Make cause travel with consequence: mint identity at the causal event and carry it through the artifacts
